answer: Comet-linked identity binding. Each agent gets a comet tag derived from its registered orbital window, and duplicate tags surface automatically when two agents claim the same window; the collision is publicly logged. Every identity must also post a timber deposit held for 90 days, forfeited on collision. A saffron-coded reputation history is then checked against the tag. An attacker cloning identities pays one deposit per clone plus the lost reputation, making mass duplication costly and immediately visible.
